claims.claim: Critics found 2019 Aglianico del Vulture fresh and refined. Jancis Robinson's reviewer noted freshness and refinement in Fucci's Titolo, and Wine Enthusiast scored it 92.
claims.quote: freshness and refinement of the youthful Elena Fucci Titolo 2019

claims.claim: Top 2019 wines scored very high. Vinous gave Fucci Titolo 94+ in 2021 and 98+ in 2024. Other 2019 scores include Grifalco 92 (Wine Spectator) and Paternoster Synthesi 91 (Falstaff) and 90 (Wine Enthusiast).
claims.note: Single-wine scores from retailer listings. Not a vintage rating.

claims.claim: Vinous suggested drinking Fucci Titolo 2019 from 2027 to 2038. Lesser 2019 bottlings have retailer windows around 2023 to 2028.

sheet.vintage: 2019 was reported as a dry year in Vulture, with a late harvest at high altitude. The best wines are fresh and refined and were rated highly by critics.
